assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original medieval grain-village pixel-art review board, TWO quest spaces only, don't duplicate entire town. Match reference muted thatch, mud earth, brown wood, ochre wheat and olive greens. Coarse readable hard-edged pixel clusters, orthographic top-down oblique, horizontal walls vertical posts square-axis ground, avoid diamond-isometric. LEFT small grafting-field shelter open toward broad common field path; sample corner of two offset older and newer plough rows, a boundary stake visibly rebound with two old rope knots, modest empty bench and stored hand hoe. Low private garden fence stops before common path; a separate OPEN livestock gate joins an outer dry lane, no animal needed. RIGHT domestic old-rent cooking room reached from its OWN little path inside family fence. Cold ordinary hearth, tied small bundle of basketmaking tools put away on shelf, closed travel-money pouch on one side of table, one modest grain sack clearly separate on opposite side. Two empty seats permit separate talks, OPEN front doorway and open fence wicket give continuous independent return to street, no blocked exits. No person, wedding props, deed, signed contract, public accusation, magical effects, text or labels. Tool/travel/grain ownership undecided; scene does not imply daughter consent or crop title. Finite sparse props, not huge inventory.
assets.qa: Field shelter, rebound stake, separate cultivation rows, open livestock/public lanes and independent domestic doorway/wicket are legible. Hearth is cold; tool bundle, grain sack and small pouch separated. Extra crops and dishes decorative, no consent or crop title inferred. Perspective somewhat oblique; exact row chronology and gameplay grid unvalidated.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. TWO paired original medieval rural quest spaces, high-resolution pixel-art review only. Use reference brown timber/thatch stone muted wheat olive materials, not original mill room or map. Coarse crisp low-detail pixel clusters, orthographic top-down oblique square-axis ground, horizontal facades vertical posts, avoid diagonal isometric diamond. LEFT newly added lean-to grain-loss measuring porch beside old stopped mill exterior. Back corner contains a small motionless old wheel fully fenced behind wood railing, not usable machinery; broad dry approach outside fence. Foreground table has a shallow round measuring sieve, a small tray with husks, another tray with worn detached milling sample; NO production line, no grain delivery labor, no giant inventory. RIGHT separate simple rent-measuring room with exactly TWO independent wooden grain measures spaced well apart on table, several old notched wooden rent tallies between them, closed private folio on shelf. FRONT OPEN door joins village road; RIGHT SIDE OPEN door and short dry path joins visible high streamside footpath. Clear continuous dry passage through room without stepping over table, independent return for left porch. Stream can be hinted at far edge but path never enters water. No people, crystals, marriage, names, text, numbers, magic or payment completed. Calm daylight and restrained sparse props.
assets.qa: Stopped wheel behind rail and detached measuring porch, two distinct measures, tally sticks, open front door and side exit toward dry creekside path rendered. Porch is concept addition, not edit of original game mill. Sieve/husk/worn sample differences need close production definition; actual capacities, collision and machine safety unvalidated.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original TWO-panel medieval rural seed-and-food quest-space pixel review. Reference materials only: subdued straw thatch, brown mud, weathered wood, olive vegetation. Coarse readable pixel clusters and sparse detail, top-down-oblique orthographic square-ground axes, horizontal back walls vertical posts, no diamond-isometric. LEFT small sealed seed-storage hut raised slightly above damp ground on low timber feet. Closed PRIVATE storage door with visible old tied seal cord, a short dry stair to exterior landing, exterior public inspection table showing a tiny shallow dish of visibly sprouting sample grains and short notched measuring stick. Do not open private grain store, do not pile stock outside. Broad ordinary public bypass is always open around hut and never requires private door. RIGHT ordinary life-ration cooking shelter on lower dry village level, independently open to public path: simple small hearth, covered pot, exactly three household wooden ration bowls on bench and a single plain wooden seasonal presale tally in separate tray. Food service is physically separate from seed hut and requires no contract or entry to store. Each loading path joins common village street separately, both clearly continuous and dry. No people, hunger spectacle, text, labels, readable contract, wedding, magic, political emblems or gold. Sparse finite utensils, no completed sale/payment or new capacity claim.
assets.qa: Closed cord-sealed seed door, public sprout dish, raised dry access and open public bypass rendered. Ration hearth independently accessible, exactly three bowls and separate tally. Generator draws small lit cooking fire as ordinary hearth; no burning grain. Quantities decorative and scene does not establish completed sale or food allocation.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original medieval rural pixel-art review board, TWO small exterior quest spaces separated by narrow plain divider. Reference only muted brown timber, grey stone, olive greenery and straw thatch. Coarse pixel clusters, simple readable geometry, orthographic top-down-oblique square-axis ground, horizontal facades vertical posts, no diamond-isometric. LEFT public village WELL and small vegetable-basket canopy: low round worn shared well coping, coiled bucket rope and empty wooden bucket safely outside, exactly two distinct empty vegetable baskets under canopy. Broad OPEN public path runs directly past well and out of scene, no private gate blocking access. Nearby private vegetable plot has its own separate little gate in fence; well remains wholly OUTSIDE that garden fence. RIGHT dry high creek bridge and modest rain shelter facing bridge approach. Bridge has continuous intact deck, side rails and dry ground at BOTH ends; public route clearly goes over bridge rather than through private yard or low stepping stones. Under shelter a detached removable fence panel rests against back wall, three different small livestock bells hang separately above empty bench. No livestock trapped, no people, wedding, transferred property, ritual, magic, text, labels or completed contract. Keep route easy to read, not whole town map. Review props not exact inventory or bridge-load certification.
assets.qa: Well lies outside private garden fence; two baskets, bucket and coiled rope visible. Bridge has continuous deck joining dry ground at both ends with open approaches; rain shelter holds detached fence panel and three bells. No wedding/property transfer or animals trapped. Bridge height/load and collisions unvalidated; village house decorative.
